event.name: Gaia Healers Elevate Conference 2026
event.description: Join us November 20–22, 2026 at the Rosen Shingle Creek Hotel in Orlando for a transformative three-day experience that bridges Eastern medicine and Western science. This immersive event brings together world-renowned holistic scientists, pioneering researchers, and visionary practitioners to explore the future of integrative health. Through powerful talks, experiential workshops, and meaningful connections, you'll discover how ancient healing traditions and cutting-edge innovations come together to awaken the full potential of the human body and mind. Whether you're a practitioner or a seeker, this event is your opportunity to be part of a movement redefining wellness from the inside out.

faq.title: When and where is the Gaia Healers Elevate Conference?
faq.body: The Gaia Healers Elevate Conference takes place November 20–22, 2026 at the Rosen Shingle Creek in Orlando, Florida — one of the most beautiful resort venues in the Southeast. Plan to arrive the evening of November 19th to settle in and be ready for a full day on the 20th.

faq.title: How do I book a hotel room at the venue?
faq.body: We have a special discounted room block reserved at Rosen Shingle Creek for all Elevate attendees. After purchasing your ticket, you'll receive a confirmation email with the exclusive booking link and group rate code. We strongly recommend booking early — rooms at our group rate are limited and typically sell out weeks before the event.

faq.title: What exactly is the Gaia Healers Elevate Conference?
faq.body: Elevate is a three-day immersive wellness conference where cutting-edge science meets ancient healing wisdom. It brings together world-class speakers, hands-on workshops, live technology demonstrations, and a curated exhibit hall featuring 40+ wellness brands and innovators. Whether you're a practitioner, a seeker, or simply someone committed to living at their highest level — this event is designed for you.

faq.title: What is included with a VIP ticket?
faq.body: The VIP Pass ($999) is our most comprehensive ticket, giving you full access to all three days of the conference, the entire exhibit hall, and all workshop offerings. It's the best way to experience everything Elevate has to offer without missing a single session, demonstration, or hands-on experience.

faq.title: What is the difference between the ticket tiers?
faq.body: We offer five access levels to suit every attendee: VIP ($999) includes the full conference, exhibit hall, and all workshops. Three Day Event Pass ($650) covers the conference and exhibit hall with middle-row seating. Workshop Access ($449) grants entry to all workshop sessions only. General Admission + Conference ($249) includes the exhibit hall plus back-row conference seating. General Admission ($99) is exhibit hall access only for all three days.

faq.title: Can I upgrade my ticket after purchasing?
faq.body: Yes! You can upgrade your ticket at any time before the event, subject to availability. Simply contact our support team with your order details, and we'll walk you through the upgrade process. We recommend upgrading sooner rather than later — VIP spots are limited.

faq.title: Is my ticket refundable?
faq.body: Tickets are non-refundable but fully transferable. If you're unable to attend, you may transfer your ticket to another person at no cost up to 14 days before the event. Please contact support to arrange a transfer. In the unlikely event that the conference is cancelled or postponed, all ticket holders will be notified and offered a full credit or refund.

faq.title: What happens after I purchase my ticket?
faq.body: You'll receive an email confirmation immediately after purchase with your ticket details, hotel booking link, and a welcome packet with everything you need to prepare for the event. As we get closer to November, you'll receive a detailed schedule, speaker lineup updates, and pre-event resources to help you get the most out of Elevate.

faq.title: Are children welcome at the Conference?
faq.body: Elevate is designed as an adult-focused professional and personal development event. Children under 16 are not permitted on the conference floor or in workshop sessions. We want to ensure every attendee has the most focused, transformative experience possible. We recommend arranging childcare in advance if needed.

faq.title: Are meals included with my ticket?
faq.body: Meals are not included in ticket pricing, but the Rosen Shingle Creek offers multiple outstanding dining options on-site, and Orlando has a wide range of restaurants nearby. VIP and workshop attendees may have access to exclusive catered breaks — details will be confirmed closer to the event.

faq.title: I'm a practitioner — is this event right for me?
faq.body: Absolutely. Elevate was built with practitioners in mind. Whether you're a functional medicine doctor, naturopath, energy healer, chiropractor, nutritionist, or wellness coach — you'll find tools, technologies, protocols, and colleagues here that will directly elevate your practice. Many of our speakers are actively treating patients and will share real clinical insights you can apply immediately.

faq.title: Are there opportunities to speak, exhibit, or volunteer?
faq.body: Yes! We welcome applications from speakers, exhibitors, and volunteers who align with our mission. If you have a product, technology, or message that belongs on the Elevate stage or exhibit floor, we'd love to hear from you. Please reach out to our team with a brief description of what you'd like to bring to the event and we'll be in touch.
